definitions.same_plant: Independent double abc RL/complementarity plant,0.5us step; upper/lower440uF each,170V target,100V line RMS/50Hz,50ohm.
definitions.sensitivity: PhysicalL2.1mH/R0.26ohm + bounded ADC noise vs nominal controllerL3mH/R0.2ohm; same half440uF.
definitions.THD: Synchronous DFT2..40 on all2MHz physical midpoint samples, not CSV-decimated data.
definitions.source_limits: 7A instantaneous and204V slow-filter protection are planning thresholds, not measured component ratings.
definitions.filter: GUI filter preserves original~189ms bandwidth; original50k literal alpha retained exactly; other periods use1-(1-alpha50)^(Ts/20us).
definitions.instrumentation: Fixed10kHz physical-grid tick independent of controller rate,150V/s reference slew.
definitions.window: T-ISRoffset only; excludes vector entry/exit,ADC read overhead,write guard,three-phase skew and real driver delays.

conclusion: Numeric outcomes are screening data only. A window larger than a prior work lower bound is not a deadline pass or hardware release.
